bundle_scope.topic: per-tf window/sequence-length scheme alternatives (independent-per-tf / tapering-schedule) and candidate feature-set additions/screening parameters. Excludes the current default values (uniform-256/tf window, v1 feature schema): those are stated inline in every design-set's own `window`/`features` fields, never restated here — this bundle documents only the not-yet-adopted alternatives and the shared screening methodology.
bundle_scope.applies_to: every Optuna trial's input-shape dimension across every architecture-design candidate, plus the feature-screening pipeline run once per candidate-feature-pool addition

options: MI screen (sklearn.mutual_info_classif/regression) against each label head first — no GPU; ambiguous cases: small LightGBM/XGBoost w/ vs w/o candidate; full DL run reserved for candidates passing both
tier_1.rationale: already-resolved 3-step screening method every candidate-feature addition must pass before promotion into the schema

options: one Optuna dim per branch instead of one shared dim — larger search space, lets e.g. noisy 5min diverge from data-scarce 1W
tier_2.rationale: named alternative scheme, secondary to the uniform baseline pending evidence it's worth the larger search space

options: structural: time-since-last-peak/valley per horizon, consecutive-same-direction-candle count
tier_2.rationale: named candidate-feature pool, hypothesis-driven addition workflow: state hypothesis -> MI screen -> full run only if signal -> keep only if backtested KPI improves enough to justify cost - none promoted yet

options: candle count halves as tf increases, e.g. 2048@5min / 1024@15min / 512@1H / 256@4H / 128@1D / 64@1W — illustrative, unproven; wall-clock lookback still grows across the schedule (opposite bias from holding count constant)
tier_3.rationale: doc explicitly flags this as illustrative/unproven, to be tested against the uniform baseline not assumed better; also sharply raises attention-over-concat-seq VRAM cost for the affected branch, needs reprofiling via profile_trial_cost() before it's feasible at all

options: included only for flat/shared-encoder architectures (disambiguates mixed timeframes); excluded for per-tf-branch architectures (constant/redundant there)
tier_3.rationale: architecture-gated config option, not a free search dimension - parked here for completeness since it's still a 'feature parameter' in the literal sense

optimization_mechanics.search_method: window-length dims (uniform/independent-per-tf) are Optuna categorical/integer dims within the same single study as architecture+hparams; feature-pool additions follow the separate hypothesis-driven MI-screen workflow, not Optuna
optimization_mechanics.pruning: n/a for feature screening (no training run at MI-screen stage); Hyperband applies once a candidate feature reaches a full DL run
optimization_mechanics.budget_control: profile_trial_cost() reprofiled per window-length schedule since VRAM cost is schedule-dependent, not just count-dependent
